head: Wispr Flow Notetaker on iPhone: free AI notes for in-person meetings
dek: Wispr Flow's Notetaker, its AI meeting notes tool, is now in the free Wispr Flow iPhone app: you record a meeting in the room and get a transcript, a summary and action items. Notes sync with the Mac and Windows apps.
details: The update came out on the App Store on 18 November (version 2.0.3); dictation keeps working as before. No bot joins your calls, and you can ask the AI questions about past meetings from your phone. The free plan includes a set number of meeting notes each week, recordings under five minutes don't count, and meetings older than 30 days lock until you upgrade. Wispr says Android support is coming soon.
where: iPhone (free, in-app purchases), with Mac and Windows; Android not yet
means: If you sit in meetings, interviews or classes, your phone can now take the notes and hand you the to-do list afterwards, free up to a weekly limit.
todo: Update Wispr Flow on the App Store or download it. Tell everyone in the room before you start recording; Wispr asks you to do so.
thumb_words: WISPR FLOW NOTETAKER COMES TO IPHONE
